feature_requests.title: Unified Capital & Leverage Cockpit
feature_requests.rationale: Single screen showing deployed capital, free margin, notional exposure (delta-adjusted for options), and leverage ratio across equity intraday + monthly F&O + weekly index options. Unlocks the 'am I over-leveraged right now?' decision before adding any new position — critical when straddles and pyramids stack silently.

feature_requests.title: Strategy Edge Decay Chart (rolling expectancy by strategy)
feature_requests.rationale: Rolling 20/60-trade expectancy, win-rate, and avg R per strategy plotted over time, with a regime overlay (trending vs choppy NIFTY). Lets me kill or down-size strategies whose edge has decayed before the monthly P&L tells me. Today the monthly report is lagging — this is the leading indicator.

feature_requests.title: Plan vs Actual Reconciliation Report
feature_requests.rationale: For every AI-generated plan (directional, straddle, pyramid, spread), compare planned entry/SL/target/size vs what actually executed and the realised outcome. Surfaces slippage, sizing drift, and SL-honour rate. Without this I can't tell if the AI plans are good and execution is bad, or vice versa.

feature_requests.title: Options Greeks Heatmap (portfolio-level delta/gamma/theta/vega)
feature_requests.rationale: Live aggregated Greeks across ALL open option positions (straddles + pyramids + spreads) by underlying and expiry bucket, with a gamma-risk badge for expiry-day positions. Unlocks the 'should I hedge or close before 3:15' decision — currently I have to eyeball positions one-by-one.

feature_requests.title: Signal-to-Trade Funnel (capture-rate breakdown)
feature_requests.rationale: Funnel view: signals fired → passed risk gate → executed → profitable, sliced by strategy and rejection reason from @RiskGuard. Tells me whether I'm leaving edge on the table due to over-tight risk limits or capital cap. Complements the monthly capture matrix but live/intraday instead of EOD.

files_changed.approach: New service module that walks open Position rows for the tenant's portfolio(s), buckets them into equity-intraday / monthly-FNO / weekly-index-options, computes notional + delta-adjusted notional using cached option Greeks (fallback delta=1.0 for equity, 0.5 for ATM options when Greeks unavailable), and returns a single dict consumed by the view. Keeps all aggregation logic out of the view layer f

from apps.portfolio.models import Portfolio, Position

BUCKET_EQUITY = 'equity_intraday'
BUCKET_FNO_MONTHLY = 'fno_monthly'
BUCKET_OPT_WEEKLY = 'options_weekly'

def _classify(position) -> str: ...   # by instrument_type + expiry distance
def _delta_for(position) -> float: ...# greeks cache lookup, fallback by moneyness
def _notional(position) -> Decimal: ...# qty * ltp * lot_size

def build_capital_cockpit(tenant, portfolio: Portfolio | None = None) -> dict:
    portfolios = [portfolio] if portfolio else list(Portfolio.objects.filter(tenant=tenant))
    deployed = Decimal('0'); notional = Decimal('0'); delta_notional = Decimal('0')
    per_bucket = {b: {'notional': 0, 'delta_notional': 0, 'count': 0} for b in (BUCKET_EQUITY, BUCKET_FNO_MONTHLY, BUCKET_OPT_WEEKLY)}
    total_capital = sum((p.capital for p in portfolios), Decimal('0'))
    for pos in Position.objects.filter(portfolio__in=portfolios, status='OPEN'):
        bucket = _classify(pos)
        n = _notional(pos); d = n * Decimal(_delta_for(pos))
        deployed += pos.margin_used or Decimal('0')
        notional += n; delta_notional += abs(d)
        per_bucket[bucket]['notional'] += float(n)
        per_bucket[bucket]['delta_notional'] += float(abs(d))
        per_bucket[bucket]['count'] += 1

files_changed.approach: New React component (TanStack Query hook on /portfolios/capital-cockpit/) rendering KPI tiles for total capital, deployed, free margin, notional, delta-adjusted notional, leverage ratio, plus a small per-bucket table. Uses existing Card/KPI primitives + fmtInr/fmtPct from lib/utils. Wire it into DashboardPage as a top tile.
Add a typed fetcher + interface for the cockpit endpoint. Uses the existing `api` axios instance (v2 backend); no envelope unwrap needed since the response is a single object.

risks: Delta fallback heuristic (0.5 ATM, 1.0 equity) may understate gamma-day exposure if greeks cache is cold — leverage_ratio could look artificially low on expiry day.
URL ordering: if 'capital-cockpit/' is registered after the PortfolioViewSet catchall router, the detail route `(?P<pk>[^/.]+)/` will swallow it and return 404 / wrong-shape payload.

Position.margin_used may be null for paper/legacy rows — deployed_capital would be zero and free_margin would equal total_capital, masking actual deployment. Need an explicit COALESCE or fallback to n
